600 seconds).\n227\t    pub fn with_timeout(mut self, timeout_secs: u64) -> Self {\n228\t        self.timeout_secs = timeout_secs;\n229\t        self\n230\t    }\n231\t\n232\t    /// Run cargo test with the configured arguments.\n233\t    ///\n234\t    /// ## Errors\n235\t    ///\n236\t    /// Returns an error if:\n237\t    /// - The cargo binary cannot be found\n238\t    /// - The workspace directory is invalid\n239\t    /// - The process cannot be spawned\n240\t    pub fn run(&self) -> Result<TestOutcome> {\n241\t        let start = Instant::now();\n242\t        let args = self.args.build_args();\n243\t\n244\t        tracing::info!(\n245\t            workspace = %self.workspace.display(),\n246\t            args = ?args,\n247\t            \"running cargo test\"\n248\t        );\n249\t\n250\t        // Build the cargo command\n251\t        let mut cmd = Command::new(\"cargo\");\n252\t        cmd.args(&args);\n253\t        cmd.current_dir(&self.workspace);\n254\t        cmd.stdout(Stdio::piped());\n255\t        cmd.stderr(Stdio::piped());\n256\t\n257\t        // Spawn the process\n258\t        let mut child = cmd.spawn().context(\"failed to spawn cargo test\")?;\n259\t\n260\t        // Wait for completion with timeout\n261\t        let timeout = Duration::from_secs(self.timeout_secs);\n262\t        let _exit_status = loop {\n263\t            match child.try_wait() {\n264\t                Ok(Some(status)) => break status,\n265\t                Ok(None) => {\n266\t                    if start.elapsed() >= timeout {\n267\t                        child\n268\t                            .kill()\n269\t                            .context(\"failed to kill cargo test after timeout\")?;\n270\t                        return Ok(TestOutcome {\n271\t                            exit_code: None,\n272\t                            stdout: String::new(),\n273\t                            stderr: String::from(\"command timed out\"),\n274\t                            duration: start.elapsed(),\n275\t                            timed_out: true,\n276\t                        });\n277\t                    }\n278\t                    std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100));\n279\t                }\n280\t                Err(e) => {\n281\t                    return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(\"failed to wait for cargo test: {}\", e));\n282\t                }\n283\t            }\n284\t        };\n285\t\n286\t        // Capture output\n287\t        let output = child\n288\t            .wait_with_output()\n289\t            .context(\"failed to capture cargo test output\")?;\n290\t\n291\t        let stdout = truncate_output(&String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout));\n292\t        let stderr = truncate_output(&String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr));\n293\t\n294\t        tracing::info!(\n295\t            exit_code = ?output.status.code(),\n296\t            duration_secs = start.elapsed().as_secs(),\n297\t            success = output.status.success(),\n298\t            \"cargo test completed\"\n299\t        );\n300\t\n301\t        Ok(TestOutcome {\n302\t            exit_code: output.status.code(),\n303\t            stdout,\n304\t            stderr,\n305\t            duration: start.elapsed(),\n306\t            timed_out: false,\n307\t        })\n308\t    }\n309\t\n310\t    /// Get the workspace directory.\n311\t    pub fn workspace(&self) -> &Path {\n312\t        &self.workspace\n313\t    }\n314\t\n315\t    /// Get the test arguments.\n316\t    pub fn args(&self) -> &TestArgs {\n317\t        &self.args\n318\t    }\n319\t\n320\t    /// Get the timeout in seconds.\n321\t    pub fn timeout_secs(&self) -> u64 {\n322\t        self.timeout_secs\n323\t    }\n324\t\n325\t    /// Run cargo test and write output to files.\n326\t    ///\n327\t    /// This method runs `cargo test` and writes the captured stdout, stderr,\n328\t    /// and combined output to separate files in the `.test_outputs/<test_name>/` directory.\n329\t    ///\n330\t    /// ## Arguments\n331\t    ///\n332\t    /// * `test_name` - A unique identifier for the test (e.g., \"integration_test_1\")\n333\t    ///\n334\t    /// ## Errors\n335\t    ///\n336\t    /// Returns an error if:\n337\t    /// - The test run fails\n338\t    /// - Output directory creation fails\n339\t    /// - File writing fails\n340\t    ///\n341\t    /// ## Example\n342\t    ///\n343\t    /// ```no_run\n344\t    /// use needle::cargo_test::CargoTest;\n345\t    /// use std::path::Path;\n346\t    ///\n347\t    /// let runner = CargoTest::new(Path::new(\"/workspace\"));\n348\t    /// let outcome = runner.run_with_output_files(\"my_test\").unwrap();\n349\t    /// ```\n350\t    pub fn run_with_output_files(&self, test_name: &str) -> Result<TestOutcome> {\n351\t        // First run the test to get the outcome\n352\t        let outcome = self.run()?;\n353\t\n354\t        // Create test output directory and write outputs\n355\t        if let Some(output) = TestOutput::new(test_name, &self.workspace) {\n356\t            // Write stdout\n357\t            if let Err(e) = output.write_stdout(&outcome.stdout) {\n358\t                tracing::warn!(\n359\t                    test_name = %test_name,\n360\t                    error = %e,\n361\t                    \"failed to write stdout to file\"\n362\t                );\n363\t            }\n364\t\n365\t            // Write stderr\n366\t            if let Err(e) = output.write_stderr(&outcome.stderr) {\n367\t                tracing::warn!(\n368\t                    test_name = %test_name,\n369\t                    error = %e,\n370\t                    \"failed to write stderr to file\"\n371\t                );\n372\t            }\n373\t\n374\t            // Write combined output\n375\t            let combined = create_combined_output(&outcome.stdout, &outcome.stderr);\n376\t            if let Err(e) = output.write_combined(&combined) {\n377\t                tracing::warn!(\n378\t                    test_name = %test_name,\n379\t                    error = %e,\n380\t                    \"failed to write combined output to file\"\n381\t                );\n382\t            }\n383\t\n384\t            tracing::info!(\n385\t                test_name = %test_name,\n386\t                stdout_path = %output.stdout_path().display(),\n387\t                stderr_path = %output.stderr_path().display(),\n388\t                combined_path = %output.combined_path().display(),\n389\t                \"test output written to files\"\n390\t            );\n391\t        } else {\n392\t            tracing::warn!(\n393\t                test_name = %test_name,\n394\t                \"failed to create test output directory, output files not written\"\n395\t            );\n396\t        }\n397\t\n398\t        Ok(outcome)\n399\t    }\n400\t}\n401\t\n402\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n403\t// Utility Functions\n404\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n405\t\n406\t/// Truncate output to at most MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES.\n407\tfn truncate_output(s: &str) -> String {\n408\t    if s.len() <= MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES {\n409\t        s.to_string()\n410\t    } else {\n411\t        let truncated = &s[..MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES];\n412\t        format!(\"{}... [truncated]\", truncated)\n413\t    }\n414\t}\n415\t\n416\t/// Create combined output from stdout and stderr.\n417\t///\n418\t/// This function combines stdout and stderr into a single string with section headers.\n419\t///\n420\t/// ## Example\n421\t///\n422\t/// ```\n423\t/// use needle::cargo_test::create_combined_output;\n424\t///\n425\t/// let stdout = \"Test output line 1\\nTest output line 2\";\n426\t/// let stderr = \"Error message\";\n427\t/// let combined = create_combined_output(stdout, stderr);\n428\t/// ```\n429\tpub fn create_combined_output(stdout: &str, stderr: &str) -> String {\n430\t    let mut combined = String::new();\n431\t\n432\t    if !stdout.is_empty() {\n433\t        combined.push_str(\"=== STDOUT ===\\n\");\n434\t        combined.push_str(stdout);\n435\t        if !stdout.ends_with('\\n') {\n436\t            combined.push('\\n');\n437\t        }\n438\t    }\n439\t\n440\t    if !stderr.is_empty() {\n441\t        if !combined.is_empty() {\n442\t            combined.push('\\n');\n443\t        }\n444\t        combined.push_str(\"=== STDERR ===\\n\");\n445\t        combined.push_str(stderr);\n446\t        if !stderr.ends_with('\\n') {\n447\t            combined.push('\\n');\n448\t        }\n449\t    }\n450\t\n451\t    combined\n452\t}\n453\t\n454\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n455\t//
